headlines.title: Linde stock rises 3% on third-quarter earnings, revenue beats
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- On Thursday, Linde plc (NASDAQ:LIN) reported third-quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, with adjusted earnings per share of $4.59 beating the consensus estimate of $4.52 by $0.07.

headlines.title: Linde (LIN) Surpasses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
headlines.summary: Linde (LIN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.55% and +2.45%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

headlines.title: Linde Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results
headlines.summary: WOKING, England, October 29, 2026--Linde plc (Nasdaq: LIN) today reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $1,692 million and diluted earnings per share of $3.66, down 12% and 11%, respectively. Excluding Linde AG purchase accounting impacts and cost reduction program and other charges, adjusted net income was $2,122 million, up 7% versus prior year. Adjusted diluted earnings per share was $4.59, 9% above prior year.

headlines.title: How Will Linde Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
headlines.summary: Linde (NASDAQ:LIN) is scheduled to report its earnings on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The company has a market value of about $235.3 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $35.4 billion in revenue and $9.6 billion in operating profit, with net income of $7.2 billion.

description: Linde plc operates as an industrial gas company worldwide. The company offers atmospheric gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, argon, and rare gases; and process gases, such as hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, electronic gases, specialty gases, and acetylene. It also engages in the design and construction of turnkey process plants for third-party customers, as well as for its gas businesses, including air separation, hydrogen, synthesis, olefin, and natural gas plants. The company serves the healthcare, chemicals and energy, manufacturing, metals and mining, food and beverage, and electronics industries. It operates in the United States, Brazil, Mexico, Canada, Germany, the United Kingdom, Eastern Europe, China, Australia, South Korea, and India. Linde plc was founded in 1879 and is based in Woking, the United Kingdom.
